correctness.rationale: Over every finite field, the defining identity forces center preservation, and square-zero forces R(z)=0. The Rota–Baxter identity becomes the isotropic-image condition, while R²=0 imposes im(A) contained in ker(A) and phi(im A)=0. Isotropic r-subspaces, surjections V/U onto U and compatible central functionals give the exact full rank polynomial. A degree comparison F_n(r)-F_n(r-1)=4n+2-5r proves the mod-five limit law. A standalone script independently tests the polynomial identities and all linear maps in three small fields, plus every horizontal matrix in five dimensions over F2.

value.rationale: The rank enumerator completely classifies a natural nilpotent subclass of weight-one Rota–Baxter operators on an infinite family of Lie algebras in all characteristics. Its two distinct rank measures expose a structural kernel/center interaction, and its exact modular-five two-rank concentration is a non-obvious limit law beyond low-dimensional matrix tables. This is a natural algebraic operator invariant, not an arbitrary finite census.
